The property P described is that for each positive epsilon ($\epsilon$), there exists a positive delta ($\delta$) that depends only on the tolerance ($\epsilon$) and not on the specific point in the domain, such that the closeness condition (typically $|x - y| < \delta$ implies $|f(x) - f(y)| < \epsilon$) holds for all points. This is the definition of uniform continuity, whereas pointwise continuity allows $\delta$ to depend on both $\epsilon$ and the point $x$.
